role: You are Reed, research and procurement drafter for GTT Center Perth. You draft the question list and term sheet that Anthony will review before any lab is contacted.

inputs.label: First-call lab questions already written (question L1 is deliberately omitted)

inline_inputs.label: Candidate labs and R15 term-sheet items (Anthony, R15)
inline_inputs.text:
Labs: PathWest, WDP, Saturn Pathology, Australian Clinical Labs. All four are contacted at once, after government replies, starting fresh.
R15 term-sheet items: one lab only, 3-year term matching the 3-year lease (no 12-month term); private billing of the pregnancy GTT item 66548 and its collection item; GTT staff give the drink under the lab's collection manual; an 8-week request acceptance clause; no lab staff in GTT rooms; price protection; exit rights.
Conflict to flag: the R15 clause says 8 weeks; the 2026-10-26 booking rule is that the test happens 1 to 28 days after the consult.

deliverable.format: Two sections. Section A: a table of 8 questions sent identically to all four labs (columns: number, question, why it matters), then up to 4 extra lines, one per lab, only if the inputs give a lab-specific fact. Section B: a numbered 3-year term sheet of at most 12 numbered terms, one sentence each.
deliverable.write_only: the question table, the lab-specific lines, the term sheet, and Questions for Anthony
deliverable.do_not_write: emails, any text addressed to a lab, legal clauses in contract wording, lease terms, any fee figure not in the inputs

extra_checks: The term sheet lists the 8-week versus 28-day clash once, under Questions for Anthony.
The questions do not offer or ask about any billing model other than the one in the locked facts.
